crossRefs.note: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.
The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but…
God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to…
Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after…
If you died with Christ from the elements of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves…
knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed…

parallels.note: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but…

translations.web: “Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”
translations.bsb: “Why do Your disciples break the tradition of the elders? They do not wash their hands before they eat.”
translations.kjv: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
translations.asv: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
